name: With Eyes Full of Stardust
source:
"He's just a boy... who happens to be a friend... in my dreams."
"So... a dream boyfriend?"

For the past few weeks, your dreams have become very vivid. And that's all thanks to Stardust, your dream friend, not boyfriend. You continue to grow closer to each other every night that passes. However, lately the dreams have become a little more magical... to the point of interfering with real life.

You're a hard working university student whose sole focus has been getting into graduate school. You shouldn't be distracted by a magical flight of fancy.

Right?

[from [url=https://derpychocho.itch.io/with-eyes-full-of-stardust]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“他只是个男孩……恰好是我梦中的朋友……”
“所以……是梦中男友？”

过去几周，你的梦变得格外真实。这都要归功于星尘——你的梦中朋友，不是男朋友。每过一夜，你们的关系都会更加亲密。然而最近，梦境变得更加魔幻，甚至开始影响现实。

你是一名努力学习、唯一目标是考上研究生的大学生。不该被魔法般的异想天开分心。

对吧？
